build_pca_whitening: build a PCA whitening transformer that reduces feature dimensionality using eigendecomposition
create_pca_fit_transform: create a PCA instance and fit-transform numpy or torch tensor features to reduced dimensions
run_pca_transform: run PCA transform on new features using a previously fitted PCA model
create_pca_save_load: create a PCA model, train it on features, and save it to disk for later loading
run_pca_to_cuda: run PCA model to_cuda to move mean and transformation matrix to GPU
